purpose: Screen an established localization-quality scorer as a stronger ordinary control, NOT as an innovation candidate.

Fixed coefficient1 and bounded correction[-1,1]. Exact-zero r returns original score bit-for-bit; all coordinates/classes/count/order preserved. No per-model threshold or truncation.
repetition: Seed0 first. Only after all six gates pass, run1/2 with same recipe/data but new common random initial hidden weights and batch order. Require>=2/3positive, mean tiny/small_all gain>=.10pp and every FPPI budget. No epoch/seed/model selection from heldout results.
